product_metadata.title: KITCHENATICS Nonstick BPA-free Small Silicone Molds for Candy, Emoji Molds Silicone for Mini Candy Molds, Jello, Gummy Candy, Silicone Baking Molds for Kids Adults, Smiley Face Mold Silicone Set, 4 Pc
features: SET COMES WITH 4 HIGH QUALITY SILICONE BAKING TRAY MOLDS: Each sheet has 15 individual emojis circle per mold, with a total of 60 emoji shapes molder. Each sheet is 8.3”-inch x 4.3”-inch x 0.60”-inch, 0.50”-inch deep and 1.4” inch wide.

FUNNY FACE SILICONE MOLDS FOR CANDY: Make sweet treats with these round emoji gummy molds. Best for chocolates, jello jiggler, soft and hard candy, truffles, flavored ice cube shaper, butter molds, cake toppers, fruit snack molds, & other edibles.
BPA-FREE, SAFE FOR FOOD USE: Made with 100% platinum food grade silicone, our silicone jello mold set have undergone testing to ensure superior food safety.
EASY TO USE & EASY-RELEASE EMOJI MOLD: Our nonstick silicone candy molds bite size allow for easy release of candies when they’re finished hardening; No need to spray oil or use melted butter.
EASY CLEAN, DISHWASHER-SAFE: Each candy making kit mold can be hand washed or simply thrown in the dishwasher for no mess clean up.

FLEXIBLE, EASY TO BEND MOLDS: You can stretch, fold, or bend without tearing this silicone mold. You don’t have to worry about breaking delicate goodies. Pinch and twist the BPA free silicone molds and you won’t see any white marks on them.

OVEN, MICROWAVE & FREEZER SAFE: The mini silicone molds can withstand temperatures from -104°F (-75.6°C) to 446°F (230°C). Easily remelt chocolates without damaging the molds. DO NOT EXPOSE TO OPEN FLAME.

MULTI-USE SILICONE MOLDS FOR ALL AGES: Surprise family & friends with unique emoji molds to make sweet treats for birthday, anniversary, bridal showers & more! Use the silicone molders for tiny scented candles, mini soaps, bath bombs, crayon molds.

INCLUDES A CANDY RECIPE E-BOOK: With each silicone funny emojis set, you'll get a free Sweet Delights recipe ebook. A fun & easy collection of truffle, candy and chocolate recipes that make the perfect companion to your new emoji faces round molds.

HASSLE-FREE WARRANTY: Simply reach out to KITCHENATICS for a fast, free replacement if your product is delivered defective in any way. We know you will love your new molds, and we enjoy hearing from our valued customers.
